title: Crimson Reverie
description: Bold sweeps of deep cadmium red and luminous raw gold, layered with intuitive palette knife strokes to evoke passion, memory, and grounded warmth.

title: Urban Nocturne
description: Reflective twilight rain over city pavements, quiet amber street lamps, and shadowy architecture rendered in textured oil glazes.

title: Bloom & Scatter
description: Expressive floral study in organic blush, terracotta, and soft olive tones. Painted with spontaneous energy directly from fresh studio garden blooms.

title: Oceanic Drift
description: Rich cerulean and seafoam layers crashing against weathered coastal rocks, capturing the eternal breath and rhythm of the open tide.

title: Jazz Composition
description: Rhythmic lines and improvisational brushwork inspired by late-night jazz solos in the studio, finished in warm charcoal, brass, and sepia.

title: Golden Meadow
description: Sunlit rolling fields bathed in late afternoon golden hour light. Gentle textural glazes invite a sense of peace and breathing space.

title: Textured Silence
description: Heavy impasto plaster, natural sands, and matte earth pigments creating a sculptural relief that shifts beautifully as daylight traverses your room.

title: Wild Spirit
description: Dynamic, untamed equine silhouette bursting through subtle earth pigments and gold leaf dust, embodying raw freedom and strength.

title: Pollock Dreams
description: Rhythmic action painting featuring intricate dripped and poured pigment webs, celebrating uninhibited gesture and visceral motion.

title: Figure in Blue
description: An intimate figurative contemplation draped in ultramarine and warm sienna, evoking quiet introspection and serene grace.

title: Modern Cascade
description: Geometric balance meets fluid spontaneity. Minimalist forms in warm ochre, muted slate, and soft linen white.

title: Giclée Reverie I
medium: Archival Giclée Print on Cotton Rag
description: Museum-grade archival pigment print on 310gsm 100% cotton rag paper. Hand-signed and numbered by Nandita Albright with Certificate of Authenticity.

title: Coastal Morning Mist
description: Soft atmospheric morning mist drifting over coastal headlands, rendered in subtle layers of oil with delicate knife detail.
